propositions: The test runs 6 rounds of 4 tickets but detects its target regression (F3/F6: exit 0 with incomplete payload) deterministically on round 0 only, wasting 48 CLI subprocesses to do so.
Fault-seeding F1 (lock timeout revert) left the test GREEN despite being a named regression; only held-lock tests detected it, proving this test's detection value is exclusive to F3/F6.

Measuring the detection floor via successive round reduction shows F3 and F6 are caught reliably at 1 round (5/5 repeats each) while F2 and F4 remain RED and F1/F5/F7 stay GREEN, matching the 6-round detection column exactly.

Wall-clock latency reduced from 17.03s to 2.9–3.4s locally (83% reduction) and dropped below CI slowest-25 floor on all matrix jobs, eliminating it as the largest default-suite variance contributor without introducing flakiness or weakening assertions.
